nodes.description: Public owner address; controls minting, whitelist/blacklist and safeOwner changes.
Secondary privileged address that can be reassigned by owner and bypasses transfer restrictions.
Threshold amount set when owner self-transfers; used to gate whether other senders may transfer.
Whitelist mapping that exempts addresses from transfer restrictions.
Blacklist mapping that blocks addresses from transferring unless they are safeOwner or recipient is the uniswap router.
Internal token balance ledger keyed by address.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Caller-controlled origin of the transaction; compared against _owner for privileged functions.
Public ERC20 transfer; routes through _approveCheck with _msgSender as sender.
Owner-only batched transfer that also whitelists receivers and approves the uniswap router.
Public allowance-based transfer; applies _approveCheck and decrements allowance.
Internal unchecked transfer helper updating _balances.
Public mint guarded by msg.sender == _owner; inflates supply and owner balance.
Restricted transfer path guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Modifier implementing whitelist/blacklist/sellAmount transfer gating and blacklisting senders.
Internal allowance setter updating _allowances.
Owner-only function that whitelists an array of receivers.
Owner-only function that reassigns the _safeOwner privileged address.
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of receivers.
Silent blacklist/whitelist state mutation triggered inside the transfer path.
Comparison amount < _sellAmount that can block or allow transfers and blacklist senders.
sender address parameter of burnTokenCheck/_approveCheck/_transfer.
recipient address parameter of burnTokenCheck/_approveCheck/_transfer.
uint256 amount parameter compared against _sellAmount and applied to balances.
address[] array parameter of multiTransfer/increaseAllowance/addApprove.
address parameter assigned to _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
Loop counter i used in multiTransfer, increaseAllowance and addApprove.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as sender into transfer via _msgSender for _approveCheck.
multiTransfer is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
msg.sender determines the allowance owner checked and decremented in transferFrom.
_mint is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner) allowing arbitrary supply inflation by owner.
increaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
decreaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
addApprove is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner).
_owner is compared with msg.sender to authorise multiTransfer.
_owner is both the authorisation subject and the balance credited in _mint.
_owner participates in every branch of the burnTokenCheck gating logic.
_owner is compared with msg.sender to authorise increaseAllowance.
_owner is compared with msg.sender to authorise decreaseAllowance.
_owner is compared with msg.sender to authorise addApprove.
_safeOwner exempts senders from restriction and can be reset by owner-self transfers.
_sellAmount is compared with amount to decide whether to allow or blacklist the transfer.
_whiteAddress[sender] short-circuits the transfer restriction check.
_blackAddress[sender] enforces the router/safeOwner exemption requirement.
multiTransfer invokes transfer for each receiver, amplifying owner privileges.
multiTransfer whitelists receivers and approves the uniswap router for max uint256.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
burnTokenCheck modifier wraps the body of _approveCheck.
burnTokenCheck mutates _blackAddress and _whiteAddress to silently blacklist senders.
burnTokenCheck applies the amount < _sellAmount gate before allowing transfer.
decreaseAllowance writes the caller-supplied address into _safeOwner, transferring privileges.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] to true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress[receivers[i]].
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress[receivers[i]].
_approveCheck subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances using SafeMath.
_transfer updates both sides of _balances with sub and add.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint credits amount to _balances[_owner].
sender parameter drives every branch and blacklist decision of burnTokenCheck.
recipient parameter is compared against _owner, _safeOwner and _unirouter.
amount parameter is compared against _sellAmount in the burnTokenCheck gate.
receivers array is iterated by multiTransfer to distribute tokens.
receivers array is iterated by increaseAllowance to whitelist addresses.
receivers array is iterated by addApprove to blacklist addresses.
safeOwner parameter is stored directly into the privileged _safeOwner variable.
loop counter i indexes receivers and approvecount in multiTransfer.

normalization_plan.reason: sender parameter is only meaningful as input to the burnTokenCheck gating modifier and should be folded into it.
recipient parameter is only used inside the burnTokenCheck restriction logic and should be folded into it.
amount parameter is consumed solely by the burnTokenCheck sellAmount comparison and should be folded into it.
receivers array parameter is the batch input of multiTransfer and its whitelist/blacklist loops.
safeOwner parameter is written straight into _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance and has no other use.
local loop counter i is an iteration detail of multiTransfer and should be absorbed into it.
